approvedSculptureModels.notes: SMK 3D scan of plaster cast KAS434 (Venus de Milo). Downloaded from the SMK Open API (files_3D: w0892g669_smk-venus-de-milo.stl, SHA-256 96e9c5a8e380c3b932526fc561233dffb3c9dbd0549ed9efc956a47851511020; API rights field = Public Domain Mark 1.0). SMK also publishes this scan on Sketchfab under CC0. Processed for Musewalk: 274,272 → 23,992 triangles with meshoptimizer 0.25.0, Z-up → Y-up, scaled to 3.83 m after the engine factor, rotated 180° to face the entrance; normals are recomputed at load.
